Description: Ground-truth attribution target label (0 = Human, 1 = AI).
SHA-1 hash identifier for the commit.
GitHub repository identifier (owner/repo).
Data source origin (AIDev or David Lo).
Parent Pull Request identifier number.
Timestamp of parent Pull Request creation (UTC ISO format).
Total GitHub repository stargazers count (filtered >= 500 stars).
GitHub username of the commit author.
Git author display name reported in the commit header.
Git author email address.
GitHub username of the committer.
Full commit message text (title plus body).
First line (summary title) of the commit message.
Body text lines of the commit message following the title.
Total character count in the full commit message.
Flag indicating message contains >1 sentence (regex sentence boundary).
Flag indicating reference to an issue ID (e.g., #123, GH-45).
Flag indicating bug fix intent (fix, bug, patch, issue, resolve).
Flag indicating new feature intent (feat, add, new, implement).
Flag indicating code refactoring intent (refactor, clean, simplify).
Flag indicating performance optimization intent (perf, optimize, speed).
Flag indicating documentation update intent (doc, docs, readme, comment).
Flag indicating test suite modifications (test, tests, spec, coverage).
UTC hour when commit was authored (0--23).
Day of the week when authored (0 = Monday to 6 = Sunday).
Flag indicating commit authored on Saturday or Sunday.
Flag indicating authoring outside standard working hours (before 09:00 or after 18:00 UTC).
Regularity index of commit authoring timestamps.
Total lines of code added in the commit.
Total lines of code deleted in the commit.
Total changed lines of code (additions + deletions).
Total count of files modified in the commit.
Average modified lines per file (total_changed / files_changed).
Ratio of additions to total changed lines (additions / total_changed).
Binned change size category (xsmall, small, medium, large).
Flag indicating creation of new files in the commit.
Flag indicating removal of existing files in the commit.
Flag indicating file renaming or moving in the commit.
Flag indicating commit consists only of deletions (additions == 0).
Flag indicating massive bulk modifications (>1000 lines or >50 files).
Seconds between this commit and the previous commit in the same PR.
Seconds between this commit and the same author previous commit.
Number of commits in the same PR within a 1-hour rolling window.
Goh-Barabasi burstiness score B of repeated words in the commit message (-1.0 to 1.0).
Coefficient of variation CV of sentence lengths in the message.
Flag indicating if the message contains more than one sentence.
Average number of words between repeated occurrences (inter-arrival distance).
Average number of times each repeated word appears (burst cluster length).
Count of distinct words appearing 2 or more times in the commit message.
Total number of alphabetic tokens (>= 2 chars) in the commit message.
Total number of words in added or modified inline code comments in the diff.
Word burstiness score B of repeated tokens within inline code comments (-1.0 if uncomputable).
Sentence length burstiness of code comments (-1.0 if uncomputable).
Word burstiness score B of repeated tokens in the parent Pull Request description (-1.0 if uncomputable).
